domainFacts: The seven admin-owned columns on fsi_messagecenterlog are: fsi_assessmentstatus, fsi_assessment, fsi_assessedby, fsi_assesseddate, fsi_actionstaken, fsi_impactsagents, fsi_notifiedon. Invoke-McmDvUpsertMessage in scripts/governance/_Common.ps1 enforces that these columns are NEVER sent on the PATCH update branch (only on the conditional create-with-If-None-Match branch, where only fsi_assessmentstatus is seeded to NotAssessed). Any new human-curated column (assessment workflow, supervisor notes, etc.) must be added to this list, to the create-payload exclusion logic in _Common.ps1, AND to the set-intersection assertion in tests/Upsert.Tests.ps1.

Severity option-set fsi_MCM_messageseverity uses integer values that are NOT naturally ordered by severity: 100000000=High, 100000001=Normal, 100000002=Critical. An OData filter like 'fsi_severity ge 100000001' does NOT mean 'at least High' — it means 'Normal OR Critical' (and EXCLUDES High). To filter by ranked severity, use explicit 'in (100000000,100000002)' lists or filter on the label after expansion.

Idempotent upsert uses the alternate key fsi_MessageCenterIdKey on fsi_messagecenterid (the Graph ID, e.g. 'MC1296939'), NOT on fsi_messagecenterlogid (the system GUID primary key). The canonical upsert URL is: PATCH /api/data/v9.2/fsi_messagecenterlogs(fsi_messagecenterid='MC1296939') with header If-None-Match: * for create-only semantics. A 412 Precondition Failed response means the row already exists and the caller must fall through to the update branch (without admin-owned columns in the body).

Alternate-key index activation is asynchronous on first deploy. lab/03_Deploy-Schema.ps1 polls EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='fsi_messagecenterlog')/Keys for EntityKeyIndexStatus = Active for up to 15 minutes (configurable). Attempts to PATCH via the alt-key URL before the index reaches Active return HTTP 404, even though the row exists. Production deployments must wait for the index to activate before enabling the sync flow.

The canonical lab validation path is lab/06_Invoke-LabSmokeTest.ps1 (a 10-step orchestrator that exercises the v2.4.0 admin-field-preservation fix end-to-end with C1 regression assertions on all 7 admin-owned columns). Hand-authored flow JSON or pac solution import paths are NOT supported validation routes. Always run the numbered lab/ scripts in order (00 → 06, then 99 for teardown) against a non-prod environment. Every mutating lab script requires lab-config.json to contain the literal string 'I understand this lab must not target production' in nonProd.acknowledgement — the Assert-NonProdAcknowledgement guard is case-and-punctuation sensitive.

The HTTP-to-Graph connector is shared_webcontents ('HTTP with Microsoft Entra ID'), NOT the deprecated shared_http Premium connector. When configuring the connection, AudienceUri must be the bare resource URI 'https://graph.microsoft.com' — NOT 'https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'. The /.default suffix is OAuth scope syntax used at token-acquisition time; placing it in an Audience claim causes AADSTS500011 ('resource principal not found in tenant') on every call.

Manifest control mapping is '2.3' only — Control 2.10 (Patch Management) was removed in v2.4.0 as aspirational (this solution monitors changes; it does not patch anything). The historical Solution Catalog tables in README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md may still list both — manifest.yaml is authoritative. Do not re-add 2.10 to the manifest without an actual patch-management control implementation.

Service-principal connection references for cloud flows hit a documented security boundary: an SP-owned flow cannot bind a connection reference created under a different identity, and the maker portal hides the 'Use this connection' picker when the connection owner ≠ flow owner. Resolve by either (a) building the flow interactively as the human admin and exporting it, or (b) using HTTP-with-Microsoft-Entra-ID actions for everything outside Dataverse (which authenticate per-call instead of via a stored connection). The lab/ scripts take path (b).
